profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Collins Aerospace

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Embedded Systems · C · Python (Programming Language) · x86 Assembly · GNU Compiler Collection (GCC) · Rational DOORS · NI TestStand · NI LabVIEW · DO-178B

positions.title: REU Student Assistant
positions.description: Assisting the Biomorphic Robotics Lab, Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering with robotic research projects. Implementing path planning algorithms and motion control with mobile robots. Testing and repairing of microcontrollers.

positions.title: REU Researcher
positions.description: Programmed the Nao humanoid robot and Microsoft Kinect for teleoperation and investigated methods to improve motion mapping. Explored ways to make the Nao more agile for collision avoidance at an autonomous level. Performed a thorough sensory analysis of the Nao for future incorporation of external sensors.

positions.title: General Warehouse Worker
positions.description: Packed products into boxes, operated manual forklifts to move pallets, ran bulk for the machines and assisted section leaders and mechanics with general duties (paperwork, simple repairs, machine operation, etc.).

positions.title: IT Project Intern
positions.description: Tested for software errors, using user generated scripts in the Oracle system.
